name: Angle Euro
who_can_redeem: Any holder may redeem through supported Angle Transmuter routes, subject to protocol liquidity and fees.
redemption_region_notes: Frontend and jurisdiction restrictions may apply.
redemption_notes: EURA was previously branded agEUR and was rebranded in March 2024 without creating a separate asset identity.
summary: Euro-pegged overcollateralized stablecoin of Angle Protocol, formerly agEUR, supported by Transmuter and borrowing modules.
notes: Batch J promotion. The canonical asset launch is the agEUR mainnet launch on 2021-11-03. The 2024-03-14 EURA rename is a rebrand of the same token and is recorded separately.

name: EUR CoinVertible
who_can_redeem: Onboarded customers and permitted holders may redeem through SG-FORGE or preferred partners subject to compliance restrictions.
redemption_region_notes: US selling restrictions and permitted-transferee rules apply.
redemption_notes: Redeemable one-to-one for euro through SG-FORGE or preferred partners.
summary: MiCA-compliant euro e-money token issued by Societe Generale-FORGE and backed one-to-one by segregated cash collateral.
notes: Batch J promotion. Launch-date Batch O uses SG-FORGE’s dated launch release for EUR CoinVertible.

name: Eurite
who_can_redeem: Holders may request redemption at par subject to Banking Circle customer due diligence.
redemption_region_notes: CDD, distribution restrictions, and EEA regulatory conditions apply.
redemption_notes: Redeemable at any time at par without issuer redemption fee, subject to customer due diligence.
summary: MiCA-regulated euro e-money token issued by Banking Circle S.A., backed one-to-one by segregated euro cash.
notes: Batch J promotion. Launch-date Batch O uses Banking Circle’s dated EURI launch announcement.

name: Quantoz EURQ
who_can_redeem: Eligible holders may redeem at par through Quantoz or supported partners, subject to onboarding and terms.
redemption_region_notes: KYC, AML, jurisdiction, and distribution restrictions apply.
redemption_notes: Reserves are described as held at Tier 1 European banks and in safe government bonds.
summary: MiCA-compliant euro e-money token issued by Quantoz Payments B.V. with segregated reserve assets.
notes: Batch J promotion; reuses existing Quantoz Payments organization. Launch-date Batch O uses Quantoz’s statement that EURQ issuance began on 2024-11-18; later exchange availability remains a separate distribution event.

name: VNX Swiss Franc
who_can_redeem: Verified VNX customers may exchange VCHF with Swiss francs through supported issuer channels.
redemption_region_notes: VNX onboarding, jurisdiction, network, and issuer terms apply.
redemption_notes: The official product describes VCHF as a multichain token referencing Swiss franc; exact reserve composition is not asserted in this batch.
summary: Multichain Swiss-franc-referencing token launched by VNX Commodities on December 15, 2022 with original Ethereum issuance and issuer or exchange access, followed by later network expansions.
notes: Canonical launch is 2022-12-15, when VNX announced VEUR and VCHF launch with trading, deposit, and withdrawal access through Emirex. A 2022-12-27 first-party recap confirms December launch and Ethereum issuance. Later network launches and listings remain separate deployment or distribution boundaries.
